version_guard: No public version was verified: this identity freezes the observed methodology/source snapshot. Review task set, harness, judges, metric and configuration before importing any later result; a changed protocol needs a new identity.

scoring.metric: Relative comparison score from pairwise evaluator-v2/evaluator-v3 judgments (Thurstone-style rating; zero is near the middle of the comparison set)
scoring.notes: Values retain this source implementation and score convention; different harnesses, subsets, judge revisions and versions must remain separate.

description: Pairwise comparison of short stories written to the same constrained creative briefs, with LLM evaluator choices combined into a relative comparison score.
